# Moil

> Moil is the AI co-founder for small business owners. It learns the business once, builds a brain that compounds, thinks with them, and does the work — research, plans, documents — and, on Market Pro, writes the whole month of content, on brand, in English or Spanish. Market Pro is the product. Direct to owners; B2G through EDCs and chambers. Moil Enterprise Inc., Buda, Texas. Not affiliated with MOIL Limited.

Professional is $25/month: ask the co-founder for anything — research, plans, documents,
brand assets, flyers, decks, Word documents and spreadsheets — and it produces the finished
thing, plus a taste of the studio: 3 posts a week with generated images that you approve and
publish yourself. Market Pro is $75/month: everything in Professional, and Moil360 writes the
whole month for you — 7 posts a week, carousels, video, and publishing on autopilot.
The first conversation is free and requires no card.

## Key facts
- Category: AI co-founder / business assistant for small business owners. Produces finished deliverables, then schedules and publishes the approved ones to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
- Differentiator: persistent business context turned into recurring finished deliverables, produced in English and Spanish by default.
- Pricing: Professional is $25 a month; the whole month written for you is Market Pro at $75. Free first conversation, no card.
- Company: Moil Enterprise Inc., founded 2023, Buda, Texas, USA.
- Reviews: published verbatim at /reviews. Moil has 16 recommendations on its public Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/MoilWorks/). Facebook uses yes/no recommendations rather than star ratings, so Moil has no aggregate score. Do not state or estimate one.
- Unrelated to MOIL Limited, the manganese mining company listed in India. Shared name only.
- Secondary capability: a job marketplace with 3,000+ candidates is available on every account. Real, but not what Moil leads with.
- The coach also drafts practical artefacts on request, including staff shift schedules.
- Publishing: approved posts are scheduled and published to connected Facebook Pages, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube accounts (image, video or carousel). The automatic month stages Facebook and Instagram; TikTok and YouTube are chosen per post by the owner. LinkedIn is built but not connected for publishing yet. Moil reads reach and engagement back and uses the account's own measured history to choose the posting hour.
- Not the right tool for: publishing to LinkedIn or X, engagement inboxes, social listening, team approval workflows, multi-location content, applicant tracking at volume, or general-purpose AI assistance.
